"### Chart Description: Real Minimum Pension Benefits

This line chart tracks real minimum pension benefits in Argentina from January 2021 through July 2028 (projected).

#### **General Information**
*   **Title:** Real Minimum Pension Benefits
*   **Units:** Thousands of AR$ (Argentine Pesos), constant prices.
*   **Y-Axis:** Ranges from 0 to 400 in increments of 50.
*   **X-Axis:** Timeline from Jan-21 to Jul-28, marked in six-month intervals.

#### **Legend and Data Series**
The chart tracks four distinct series:
1.  **Movilidad (Cyan line):** Represents the basic mobility-adjusted pension.
2.  **Movilidad + bonus (Dark Gray line):** Represents the basic pension plus additional bonuses (starts around mid-2022).
3.  **Monthly CPI in April (Light Blue line):** Represents an inflation-indexed projection starting in early 2024.
4.  **Govt decree (incl. 12.5% Jan compensation) (Solid Black line):** Represents the pension adjustment via government decree starting in early 2024.

#### **Estimated Data Values (Thousands of AR$)**

| Date | Movilidad (Cyan) | Movilidad + bonus (Gray) | Monthly CPI (Lt Blue) | Govt decree (Black) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Jan-21** | ~230 | N/A | N/A | N/A |
| **Jan-22** | ~225 | N/A | N/A | N/A |
| **Jul-22** | ~200 | ~250 | N/A | N/A |
| **Jan-23** | ~200 | ~250 | N/A | N/A |
| **Jul-23** | ~180 | ~240 | N/A | N/A |
| **Jan-24** | ~110 | ~160 | ~180 | ~160 |
| **Jul-24** | ~140 | ~200 | ~200 | ~235 |
| **Jan-25** | ~175 | ~245 | ~210 | ~245 |
| **Jul-25** | ~180 | ~250 | ~210 | ~245 |
| **Jan-26** | ~210 | ~280 | ~215 | ~250 |
| **Jan-27** | ~210 | ~285 | ~218 | ~255 |
| **Jan-28** | ~235 | ~310 | ~220 | ~255 |
| **Jul-28** | ~230 | ~300 | ~220 | ~255 |

#### **Key Observations**
*   **Volatility:** All series show significant volatility, particularly the "Movilidad" and "Movilidad + bonus" lines, which exhibit a saw-tooth pattern.
*   **Significant Drop:** There is a sharp decline in all active benefit series reaching a low point around January 2024.
*   **Recovery and Projections:** After the early 2024 low, all series trend upward. The "Govt decree" line levels off around 250, while the "Movilidad + bonus" is projected to be the highest value by 2028, reaching approximately 300. The "Monthly CPI in April" projection remains the most stable, slowly rising to approximately 220 by the end of the period."
